ex.en: His argument seems illogical to me.
ex.zh: 我覺得他的論點不合邏輯。

ex.en: It's illogical to raise prices when sales are falling.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑時還漲價，這不合邏輯。

ex.en: He has been ill in bed for four days.
ex.zh: 他已經臥病在床四天了。

ex.en: Being ill, I stayed at home all day long.
ex.zh: 我生病了，整天待在家裡。

ex.en: Tom said he was ill, which was a lie.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他生病了，但那是謊話。

ex.en: You are too ready to speak ill of others.
ex.zh: 你太喜歡說別人壞話了。

ex.en: I have never heard him speak ill of others.
ex.zh: 我從來沒聽過他說別人壞話。

ex.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
ex.zh: 工作流程如下圖所示。

ex.en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
ex.zh: 讓我舉個例子來說明我的論點。

ex.en: The chart illustrates our sales growth over the past year.
ex.zh: 這張圖表說明了我們過去一年的業績成長。

ex.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
ex.zh: 幫這本書畫插圖的畫家非常厲害。

ex.en: The children's book is beautifully illustrated.
ex.zh: 這本童書的插圖畫得很漂亮。

ex.en: He could not come because of his serious illness.
ex.zh: 他因為病重而不能來。

ex.en: He was absent from school on account of illness.
ex.zh: 他因病沒去上學。

ex.en: Serious illnesses call for emergency care.
ex.zh: 重病需要緊急治療。

ex.en: This book has a lot of illustrations.
ex.zh: 這本書有很多插圖。

ex.en: The illustrations in this book are beautiful.
ex.zh: 這本書裡的插圖很漂亮。

ex.en: To give a definition of a word is more difficult than to give an illustration of its usage.
ex.zh: 為一個字下定義，比舉例說明它的用法還難。

ex.en: As an illustration, let's look at last year's sales.
ex.zh: 舉例來說，我們來看看去年的銷售。

ex.en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.
ex.zh: 房間裡的鏡面牆營造出寬敞的錯覺。

ex.en: Everything you saw was an illusion.
ex.zh: 你看到的一切都是幻覺。

ex.en: It's just an optical illusion.
ex.zh: 那只是視覺錯覺。

ex.en: He had the illusion that he was a genius.
ex.zh: 他誤以為自己是天才。

ex.en: I have no illusions about how hard this job will be.
ex.zh: 我很清楚這份工作會有多辛苦。

ex.en: It's illegal to park your car here.
ex.zh: 把車停在這裡是違法的。

ex.en: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.
ex.zh: 腳踏車騎在汽車右側是違法的。

ex.en: I've never done anything illegal in my life.
ex.zh: 我這輩子從來沒做過違法的事。
